design: Retrospective diagnostic using the completed 46 original Gain forest slates and the three ANOVA exchange draws on those same folds.
eligible: Maximum minimum approval count among candidates on this draw. If no candidate exists, all rules return the anchor.
ties: First in frozen slate order for exact score ties. Uniform has equal mass on each eligible candidate before the guard, including candidates that fall back to the anchor.
scores: Point uses the standalone empty restoration on panel one. Full uses the smallest third-largest panel slack over the frozen restoration family.
outcomes: Each nominee is checked on its guard split. The returned model is evaluated on the same outer split as its reference. U is returned compression times outer passage. Breach is an outer violation by a delivered deletion. Guard fallbacks have U and breach zero.
interval: Paired differences averaged within fold across draws, then within source across its folds. Percentile intervals resample whole sources with their complete paired records 30000 times; seed 33119. Uniform expectations are integrated exactly before resampling. Intervals are descriptive for these purposive panels.
opportunity: Tabulate slates with a real top-tier tie, distinct guarded returns in that tier, and actual within-tier variation in U or breach. Before outer scoring, bound a deterministic rule's possible gain/loss against uniform by aggregating the signed differences in guarded return probabilities times each returned support's removal fraction.
